description: This file defines the EntityService class in an Angular application, responsible for managing entities such as devices, assets, edges, tenants, customers, dashboards, and related data. It includes methods for fetching, saving, updating, and resolving entities and their aliases, as well as handling subscriptions and entity metadata.

classes.name: EntityService
classes.description: Service class providing methods to manage entities such as devices, assets, edges, tenants, customers, dashboards, and related data within an Angular application.

methods.name: getEntityObservable
methods.description: Retrieves an observable for a specific entity type and ID, calling the appropriate service based on entity type.

methods.name: getEntity
methods.description: Fetches a single entity by type and ID, returning an observable.

methods.name: getEntitiesByIdsObservable
methods.description: Fetches multiple entities by their IDs using a provided fetch function, returning an observable array.

methods.name: getEntitiesObservable
methods.description: Returns an observable for entities of a specific type and IDs, calling the appropriate service.

methods.name: getEntities
methods.description: Fetches multiple entities by their IDs, returning an observable.

methods.name: getSingleTenantByPageLinkObservable
methods.description: Retrieves tenant data based on a page link, for the current authenticated tenant.

methods.name: getSingleCustomerByPageLinkObservable
methods.description: Retrieves customer data based on a page link, for the current authenticated customer.

methods.name: getEntitiesByPageLinkObservable
methods.description: Returns paginated entities of a specific type, handling different user authorities.

methods.name: getEntitiesByPageLink
methods.description: Fetches all pages of entities of a specific type, returning an array.

methods.name: getEntitiesByNameFilter
methods.description: Searches entities by name filter with specified page size.

methods.name: findEntityDataByQuery
methods.description: Performs a query to find entity data based on a provided query object.

methods.name: findEntityKeysByQuery
methods.description: Finds entity keys based on a query, with optional scope.

methods.name: findAlarmDataByQuery
methods.description: Performs a query to find alarm data.

methods.name: findEntityInfosByFilterAndName
methods.description: Finds entity info pages filtered by a search text.

methods.name: findSingleEntityInfoByEntityFilter
methods.description: Finds a single entity info matching a filter.

methods.name: getAliasFilterTypesByEntityTypes
methods.description: Returns alias filter types applicable for given entity types.

methods.name: filterAliasByEntityTypes
methods.description: Checks if an alias filter matches given entity types.

methods.name: prepareAllowedEntityTypesList
methods.description: Prepares a list of allowed entity types based on user authority and options.

methods.name: getEntityFieldKeys
methods.description: Returns entity field keys filtered by search text.

methods.name: getAlarmKeys
methods.description: Returns alarm field keys filtered by search text.

methods.name: getEntityKeys
methods.description: Retrieves telemetry keys for an entity, filtered by type and search query.

methods.name: getEntityKeysByEntityFilter
methods.description: Retrieves telemetry keys for entities matching a filter.

methods.name: getEntityKeysByEntityFilterAndScope
methods.description: Retrieves telemetry keys for entities matching a filter and scope.

methods.name: createDatasourcesFromSubscriptionsInfo
methods.description: Creates data sources from subscription info array.

methods.name: createAlarmSourceFromSubscriptionInfo
methods.description: Creates a data source for alarms from subscription info.

methods.name: resolveAlias
methods.description: Resolves an entity alias to an entity info, considering current state parameters.

methods.name: resolveAliasFilter
methods.description: Resolves an alias filter to an entity filter result, considering current state parameters.

methods.name: checkEntityAlias
methods.description: Checks if an entity alias is valid and resolvable.

methods.name: resolveAlarmFilter
methods.description: Creates an alarm filter based on configuration and default propagation.

methods.name: saveEntityParameters
methods.description: Saves or updates an entity's parameters, including credentials and attributes.

methods.name: getSaveEntityObservable
methods.description: Returns an observable to save a specific entity type.

methods.name: getUpdateEntityTasks
methods.description: Creates update tasks for an entity based on differences between current and new data.

methods.name: saveEntityData
methods.description: Saves entity credentials, attributes, and timeseries data.

methods.name: getStateEntityInfo
methods.description: Retrieves entity ID from state parameters based on alias filter.

methods.name: createDatasourceFromSubscriptionInfo
methods.description: Creates a data source object from subscription information.

methods.name: validateSubscriptionInfo
methods.description: Validates and normalizes subscription info, especially for device type.

methods.name: prepareEntityFilterFromSubscriptionInfo
methods.description: Prepares entity filter and page link for a data source based on subscription info.

methods.name: createDatasourceKeys
methods.description: Creates data keys for a data source from key info array.

methods.name: getAssignedToEdgeEntitiesByType
methods.description: Retrieves entities assigned to an edge, filtered by entity type.

methods.name: getEdgeEventContent
methods.description: Fetches content related to an edge event, such as entity info or metadata.

methods.name: getEntitySubtypesObservable
methods.description: Retrieves subtypes for a given entity type.
